chapter: Looking back and the New York years
title: Meeting movie stars and Dallas mayors
summary: Smith met George Raft and Martha Raye and played parties for Dallas officials.

blocks.x: But some of it must have been fun. I mean, you stuck with it for a long time, Buster.

Well, I liked it... I just liked music. I was just crazy about music. And I just didn't want to give the music up. And I wanted to see what I could do, just running around and hearing all that different music, and guys playing and going on... In other words, ain't nothin' but a good time, just havin' a good time and you're living under your hat. You ain't gainin' nothin'.
Didn't you get to meet a lot of interesting people, though?
Mmm-hmm.
Wasn't that good?
Buster Smith - 152
Oh yeah. That was nice. It was all right. Yeah, we got to meet movie stars and everything else.
Did you meet movie stars?
Yeah. I met George Raft. I met Martha Raye. Now, she used to come to Kansas City all the time, come out to where we played.
She liked the music.
Mmm-hmm. Yeah.
Where did you meet George Raft?
In New York.
But when you were working with one of the bands?

No. I happened to be out at Yankee Stadium, looking at the ballgame one day. He come through there, and some of the boys knew him. I said, 'Is that George Raft?' -- he had on a green suit and purple shoes and a brown hat. And he walked up there and he shook hands with us... I remember I was always meeting... Well, even now, Emile(?) and all that, they... When they have some of these big speakers up here at this Martin Luther King Center and things like that, and I'll be up there with Emile and some of the City Councilmen and things. They all come by there. 'There's one of the old musicians there, Buster Smith,' and they'll come by and shake hands with me.
He doesn't know anything about who Buster Smith is.
No. I played for some of them. One of the Mayors
Buster Smith - 153
here, he had a big ranch out there, he's dead now -- Emile Thornton, the one they got these highways named after...
Yeah?
Yeah.
He knew about music?

No, he loved to party. He had them parties. And he had a big party, a long(?) party out there at his ranch. On the Northwest side of town. Probably about ten miles out there. And he had me bring my band out there, and we went out there and played. They had a big barbecue out there... Yeah. Emile Thornton. And Wes Wise... Several of them around here. They all knew me, because I played all around all these places -- hotels, everywhere around here.
